title: Checks for inclusive ranges where 1 is subtracted from the upper bound, e.g., x..=(y-1).
summary: The code is more readable with an exclusive range like x..y. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for exclusive ranges where 1 is added to the upper bound, e.g., x..(y+1).
summary: The code is more readable with an inclusive range like x..=y. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Nothing.
summary: This lint has been deprecated Clippy puts this lint in the deprecated group, at the level none.

title: Checks for zipping a collection with the range of 0.._.len().
summary: The code is better expressed with .enumerate(). Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.
